notes.subject: ho Khutshe
notes.rationale: Taelo ya sesole e bitelang sesole sa Egepeta hore se hole, se ipipanye, se tsoe.

notes.subject: והתהללו
notes.rationale: Hitpael wa הלל: 'ho ipipanya / ho ikaketsa' (JPS 'rush madly') kgahlanong le 'ho ikaketsa' (KJV 'rage', YLT 'boast').

notes.subject: דרכי קשת
notes.rationale: Moduso דרך o bolela 'ho penta ka meoto' kutu (ho e penta ka ho e beta ka meoto) — e ntse e le sesupo sa mmopo, eseng sebopeho se phirileng.

notes.subject: תפשי ... תפשי
notes.rationale: Phetoko e phetiwang ka bobedi (Kushe/Puthe le Baludime) e tsamaisa mokotla wa sesole; phetoko e boloka phetoko e tshwanang.

translation: Holelang, lipere, mme dikoloi-tsa-ntwa di ipipanye; mme ba-matla ba tsoe: Kushe le Puthe, ba tshwarang sehlepe, le Baludime, ba tshwarang le ho penta ka meoto kutu ya ara.
